title: Kebera OSI OS
loadFailed: OSI OS tesobodde kutandika. Ddamu ogezeeko.
instructionOne: Londa olulimi mu menu ya pulogulamu.
instructionTwo: Ggulawo ekitundu okulaba ebipimo n’ebifuga byakyo.
lugandaReview: Ebiwandiiko mu Luganda tebikebereddwa muntu mulala mu bwetengerevu.
noticeAssigned: Ekyuma kino kyamala okugattibwa ku kitundu ekirala.
noticeDemoDevice: Teekamu DevEUI entuufu ey’ennukuta 16 n’erinnya ly’ekyuma entuufu.
noticeNoEvent: Tewali kintu kitegekeddwa mu nnaku omunaana ezijja.
featureOneCopy: Ekola ku Raspberry Pi gateway yo awatali kugenda ku yintaneeti.
featureTwoCopy: Londoola era okufuge okufukirira awatali yintaneeti.
featureThreeCopy: OSI OS ewagira ebyuma 12 ebikozesebwa okupima n’okufuga okufukirira.
featureFourCopy: Kozesa dashboard mu lulimi lw’osinga okwagala.
featureFiveCopy: Buli muntu afuna olukusa olugwanira omulimu gwe.
featureSixCopy: Fuga zones, schedules n’ebikolebwa sensor bwe zituuka ku kipimo.
safeFarm: Famu ya kukoppa. Tewali kyuma kya ddala ekifugibwa wano.
guideTitle: Laba engeri omulimu gw’ennimiro gye gukolamu
guideIntro: Goberera ekkubo ettono mu magezi, ebyafaayo, okufukirira okw’ekiseera, ebivudde mu kukola ne enteekateeka. Ekirowoozo kino kikulaga byokka.
stepAdvice: Amagezi gakozesa data eriwo. Ebipimo by’embeera y’ettaka n’enteekateeka z’okufukirira birina ensalo ez’enjawulo.
stepIrrigation: Zuula ekifuga okufukirira okw’ekiseera. Ggwe olondawo okukiggulawo.
stepSkip: Kozesa essaawa ya famu okugenda ku kintu ekiddako.
stepSchedule: Ggulawo enteekateeka olabe ekiseera okufukirira we kutandikira.
stepNext: Weyongere okwetegereza oba oyige ebisingawo ku OSI OS.
resetDetail: Enkyukakyuka za famu, ebyafaayo bya vvaalu n’enteekateeka bijja kusangulwa. Olulimi lujja kusigala bwe luli.
noticeUnsupportedDevice: Okwewandiisa Milesight UC512 tekuli mu simulator eno. Tewali kyuma kyongereddwa.
formNotice: Miwendo gya kyokulabirako byokka. Bino bisigala mu session ya browser eno era tebiyunga ku server oba ekyuma.
